names.ml_final: Mean-logit full stack (mean-logit gate + memory + certificate + check, cn90 bar)

note: held-out; every threshold / hyper-parameter / bar chosen on training patients of each outer fold (inner out-of-fold predictions of the model in question); paired patient bootstrap on the same draws for all three models (rv8 pdraws, RandomState(0)); stored = published L-IMG; clean = ART clean-tile L-IMG; rand = ART random-tile-removal control (same number of tiles per sample); L-LATE = (stored L-CNV + L-IMG) / 2 in every model
